{{Top}}
{{Quote|Since the ancient seas of Coruscant lapped arcadian shores, navies have provided transportation, security, and firepower.|[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Conan Antonio Motti/Legends|Conan Antonio Motti]], ''[[Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''|<ref name="Handbook">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref>}}
[[File:RepublicVSRemnant.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The Imperial and Rebel navies assault each other.]]
A '''navy''' or '''space force''', sometime also known as a '''starfleet''', was a military service that operated in [[Realspace/Legends|outer space]]. Navies typically consisted of [[Fleet/Legends|fleets]] of [[Warship/Legends|spacecraft]] and some incorporated [[Starfighter Corps/Legends|starfighter corps]] and [[marine]] forces. Although most were space forces, some worlds still used the term "navy" to describe their maritime forces.

==Space forces==
Some spaceships were shaped like ancient traditional maritime vessels, such as the ''[[Fairwind]]''.<ref name="JVS4">[[Jedi vs. Sith 4|''Jedi vs. Sith'' 4]]</ref>

A space task force would normally include:
*[[Flagship/Legends|Flagship]] &ndash; this ship was the formal head of a space task force, and usually the seat of power for the senior officer in command of the fleet. This was usually the most powerful ship in the fleet it commanded (Ex: [[Eclipse (Eclipse-class)|''Eclipse'']], the reborn [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] flagship).
*[[Capital ship/Legends|Capital ships]] &ndash; the designation of "capital ship" referred to the size of a vessel. Capital ships measured 100m or longer. There was no upper limit on capital ship size. (Ex: a [[DP20 gunship/Legends|Corellian Gunship]] measured a mere 120m and was considered a capital ship, while an [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] measured 19,000m and was also classified as a capital ship).
*Support Ships &ndash; These vessels were usually smaller capital ships such as frigates and light cruisers used to compensate for the tactical weaknesses of larger vessels (Ex: the [[Lancer-class frigate/Legends|''Lancer''-class frigate]] was covered in anti-starfighter weaponry to protect larger warships with little anti-fighter capabilities) and/or to augment the firepower of larger vessels (Ex: in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]], two [[Strike-class medium cruiser|''Strike''-class cruisers]] were considered the equivalent of one [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]] and were used as such). These ships also encompassed other support roles such as medical vessels (Ex: The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] Fleet's primary [[Hospital ship/Legends|hospital ship]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] was a [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] called the [[Redemption/Legends|''Redemption'']]).
*[[Transport/Legends|Transports]] &ndash; these were used primarily as cargo or personnel carriers (Ex: The [[Bulk transport/Legends|Bulk transport]] saw heavy use with the Rebel Alliance Fleet as a troop transport during the Galactic Civil War).
*[[Starfighter/Legends|Starfighters]] &ndash; Fighters were small one- or two-man (sometimes three as in the case of the [[Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter/Legends|ARC-170]]) vessels used for the protection of the fleet, reconnaissance, and anti capital ship actions.

==Maritime forces==
Prior to the creation of space forces and [[Space warfare/Legends|space warfare]], navies began as maritime forces, with the earliest known use of navies being for the ancient seas of Coruscant lapped arcadian shores. Like with space forces, maritime forces provided transportation, security, and firepower.<ref name="Handbook" />

Although maritime navies of this sort were generally obsolete among space-faring planets, maritime forces were incorporated into [[Army|armies]] for the purpose of [[Ground warfare/Legends|ground warfare]], and as such were incorporated into the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]].<ref name="Handbook" />

The [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] and the [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] were among the most notable species to utilize maritime forces. Both major combatants during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], had their own maritime forces: the [[Rebel Navy (aquatic)|Rebel Navy]] and the [[Imperial Maritime Division]], although the latter was technically part of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]]. The [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]], and [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] also maintained maritime forces.<ref name="SW:GB">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
According to the ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'' DataBank, space forces evolved from maritime navies.
